prompt_fragment: This asset is a card face. Compose for a vertical 3:4 frame with a strong focal subject and room for card framing or overlay treatment.
raw_description:
Upper half: a Shadow Parliament gathering in a fire-core-lit cave-chamber
beneath the permanent ice shelf. Three hooded figures stand around a
stone table; bioluminescent ice glyphs pulse cold blue-green along the
walls. A tattered faction banner with a ☽-marked sigil hangs behind them.
Smoke from venting picks curls upward. Conspiracy and rank, not ceremony.
Lower half: warm dark surface for overlaid text, ghosted banner
watermark. Warm cream parchment frame.

formatted_prompt.scene: Ink and watercolor on aged parchment, three hooded penguin figures gathered around a stone table in a fire-core-lit ice cavern, walls pulsing cold teal bioluminescence against charcoal shadow, ember orange heat cutting through deep slate dark.

subjects.type: three adult emperor penguins, robed council figures
subjects.description: Tall lean silhouettes in charcoal wraps and volcanic-glass masks, ember-thread embroidery faintly aglow, hooded; venting-pick tools resting on stone table, posture conspiratorial and ranked
subjects.position: upper half center, arranged around stone table

subjects.description: Tattered hanging banner bearing a ☽-marked sigil, blackened and soot-frayed; bioluminescent ice glyphs lining tunnel walls, curling smoke from venting picks rising toward vaulted ice ceiling
Warm vellum parchment ground, ghosted ☽ watermark banner sigil faintly pressed beneath surface, aged foxing at edges, empty for text overlay
